text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Having spent a decent amount of time<n>with the
sunny partygoer Daitaku<n>Helios, there's one big
thing I've<n>come to notice.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Pow, pow, pow! I'm always down to<n>train it up and
blast oooff!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
What is a motivation? It's giving L<n>with a low-key
side of yikes...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy, ayy, aaayyyyy! ☆ Turn up the<n>vibes! WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her mood on any given day has a<n>tremendous
effect on her training.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
That said, Helios has been on top of<n>the world
lately, both on the track and<n>in her daily life. As long
as this keeps<n>up—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaah! But I ordered it every<n>daaay! They're
taking away the best<n>years of my liiife!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
My Limited-Time Lovey-Dovey<n>Umapyoi Pancake
Tower of Heaven...<n>I thought we were gonna be
BFFs till<n>the end...
choice_data_list: But it was a limited-time item, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but y'know how it's so over<n>when one of
your besties transfers<n>school? Same thing! For real!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Right?! I can't... I low-key think I'm at<n>an all-time
low.
choice_data_list: Want to go look for something similar?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Mm... But it's not the same. My<n>baddest bestest
bestie won't ever<n>change.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I appreciate the good vibes,<n>T-Rain! Thanks
a mil, Tray-Tray-Tray!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
My attempt to cheer her up only<n>manages to draw
out a forced smile.<n>To be honest, I only
half-understand<n>why she's down in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
But I'm Helios's trainer. I have to<n>help her break
out of this funk<n>somehow!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's up, Tray-Tray?<n>Something on the
ceiling?
choice_data_list: L-let's raise the roof with some partygoing energy!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahh! I get you, T-Rain. I totally get<n>you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You wanna become a real party<n>animal! C'mon,
you shoulda told me<n>sooner!
choice_data_list: Huh? No, that wasn't what I—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Don't be so shy! Leave it to me! I'll<n>teach you all
about how to throw<n>down!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aight, let's go! Time to get zooming!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Helios grabs me by the hand and<n>drags me
downtown before I have a<n>chance to explain
myself.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'll blast you with a banger you won'tforget, so gimme your best shot!C'mon!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Let's have some fun! Let's havesome fun! C'mon, turn it up!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Heyo! Can I get a giga-size<n>mega-max honeyade?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You gotta stack it up if you wanna<n>party, T-Rain!
Giga-stack! Got it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
No waaay! You're ice-cold, T-Rain!<n>Two plushies at
once? How pro can<n>you get?! Go, go!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wait, they fell! Ahahaha! Then we<n>gotta grab three
on the next one!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wahahaha! Why's it already<n>sunset?! Let's call it
for today, yeah?<n>☆
choice_data_list: You're back to your usual energy.
You're back to your usual energy.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
On god! ☆ I was so ready to make a<n>real partier
outta you that I got mad<n>pumped to the boom-boom
max!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
BT-dubs, we gotta keep hanging<n>since you just
made your rager<n>debut! LANE me up anytime,
'kay?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I'll show you how to throw down for<n>real next time,
too!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I never got to explain that I<n>didn't want
to become a party animal,<n>but Helios cheered up so
I guess<n>all's well that ends well.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It might even be easier to keep her<n>spirits high if I
learn more about party<n>culture... Who knows?
Maybe I really<n>will try to walk this path.
